title: Pre-registered gate for the next weekly review: decide GO/PIVOT/KILL on the growth thesis, not another week of knobs
evidence: SOURCE: the weekly review that ran 2026-09-21 09:05 (cron tc-weekly-persona-review, job 8d3ac21799d5) reported 'needs human attention' with two findings and four recommendations, and nothing actioned them -- the 11:25 ops pass closed growth-goal-stalled with 'volume is not the lever' instead. The operating agent OWNS this decision, so it is filed with the criteria LOCKED here rather than re-derived: (1) followers 157 vs the 2.53/day required for 1000 by 2027-08-20 (traj_ratio 0.07); (2) the 10->30 hashtag ramp produced zero engagement lift across five weeks; (3) three pillars (Fashion & Style, Food & Cooking, Lifestyle) carry all of the tiny signal while Beauty/Travel/Fitness/Community sit at 0.0% after 10-14 posts each; (4) reach 1-4 with 0 likes means the synthetic-account distribution is not reaching real people. DECISION (locked now, applied at the 2026-09-28 review): the gate is -- if followers < 170 AND no pillar exceeds 3% average engagement by that review, the thesis gets a GO/PIVOT/KILL decision rather than another tuning pass. Freeze hashtag volume (no further ramps: the ramp is measured to do nothing) and keep the pillar rotation as-is until the gate reads, because the ONE lever that landed today (image-grounded captions, f37136e, verified live on photo 353) has not yet produced a single post it could be judged by -- the 4090 has been held by prx-tg-pixel-posttrain-v3 all day, so renders (and therefore posts) are stalled on a shared resource, not on strategy. Judging the lever before it has run is the same mistake as re-deriving this item every pass.

notes.note: 2026-09-21 18:5xZ ops-triage: RECORDED as pre-registered and NOT actionable per pass -- closure condition and trigger named so future passes stop re-deriving it. (1) The gate and its criteria are LOCKED in this item's evidence: if followers < 170 AND no pillar exceeds 3% average engagement at the 2026-09-28 weekly review, the growth thesis gets an explicit GO / PIVOT / KILL decision instead of another tuning pass. (2) The trigger is the weekly review (tc-weekly-persona-review, 0 9 * * 1 -> next run 2026-09-28 09:00 EDT); the ops-triage pass that runs on/after that review MUST evaluate this gate against the review's own numbers and CLOSE this item with the decision as the note. Before 2026-09-28 there is nothing to action here and no note is needed. (3) Status quo is frozen meanwhile: hashtag volume stays where it is (the 10->30 ramp measured zero lift across five weeks) and the pillar rotation stays as-is, because the one lever that did land today (image-grounded captions, f37136e, verified live on photo 353) has not yet produced a post it could be judged by -- the 4090 has been held by prx-tg-pixel-posttrain-v3 since 11:30Z, so renders (and therefore posts) are stalled on a shared resource, not on strategy. (4) Failure mode this note exists to prevent: a pre-registered gate that nobody evaluates is an expected event that never fires (genome: Expected-Event Absence Detection), and the item would otherwise be re-derived as a menu of options every hour.

So the lever landed yesterday (image-grounded captions) can now start producing posts it can be judged by -- the gate's question ('was the harness actually producing?') is answerable with yes for this window. (2) THE THROUGHPUT CEILING is now measured: one render costs ~410s with the reserve (256-300s without) and the growth tick's foreground tool call is killed at ~420s, so the tick can start but never finish a render cycle -- each tick lands its render via salvage one tick later, i.e. the effective content rate is ~1 post/hour at best while the 4090 is ours. That rate, not strategy, bounds how much evidence the 09-28 review can have. Gate criteria unchanged (followers < 170 AND no pillar above 3% average engagement at the 2026-09-28 review -> explicit GO/PIVOT/KILL).
